jobs.occupation: Dental Professionals: Start Your Career in Germany! (dental assistants)  (m/w/d) (Zahnmedizinische/r Fachangestellte/r)
jobs.description:
Your Career in German Dentistry Starts Here!

Are you a skilled dental assistant currently living outside of Germany and eager to work in a dynamic German practice? We want to hear from you!

Dental Assistants from Abroad: We warmly invite qualified dental assistants from around the world to join our network and contribute their expertise. A minimum German language level of B1 is required; B2 is highly preferred.

Strong English skills are advantageous. We are excited to build a diverse and talented team!

Ipsos Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. Ipsos Healthcare is the world's leading provider of quantitative and qualitative market research studies in the pharmaceutical and medical technology sectors. The focus is on doctors, medical professionals, and, above all, patients. Our range of solutions is very diverse and covers traditional primary market research as well as scientific Real-World Evidence studies. In collaboration with our national and international clients, we conduct studies along the entire lifecycle of a healthcare product, from early demand and quality-of-life studies to projects for the preparation and accompaniment of product launches (including success measurements) and studies that help already launched products or approved preparations achieve greater success. We are looking for a Project Executive (f/m/d) for our Healthcare team at one of our locations in Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Nuremberg or Munich. Your role You support the planning, coordination, and delivery of healthcare market research and innovation projects from proposal stage through to execution. You work closely with project managers, insights teams, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to quality standards. You coordinate external suppliers and partners, tracking project progress and supporting the management of timelines, deliverables, and documentation. You maintain project documentation and ensure that project records, specifications, and study materials are complete, accurate, and up to date. You support data management activities, including data validation, quality control, and preparation of deliverables using tools such as Excel and other reporting platforms. You contribute to testing activities for surveys, research platforms, and project workflows, helping to identify issues and support process improvements and automation efforts. You assist in monitoring project risks, resolving operational challenges, and ensuring smooth collaboration across internal and external teams. You act as a reliable point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders, providing regular status updates and ensuring transparency throughout the project lifecycle. You contribute to the continuous improvement of project management processes, tools, and ways of working, including the use of AI and automation solutions. You collaborate with colleagues across Ipsos Germany and the international Healthcare network to support successful project delivery. Your profile You hold a university degree, preferably in business administration (focus on marketing/market research), social sciences, psychology, communication science, health science/public health, or a comparable field. You have initial professional experience in project management, market research, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, medical technology, or a related field through internships, working student positions, or early-career employment. You have a strong interest in project coordination, operational excellence, and delivering high-quality client work. You possess strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to managing multiple tasks and deadlines. You are comfortable working with data and have advanced Excel skills; experience with SPSS, Power BI, or Python skills are a plus. You have an interest in data management, process optimization, testing, and automation. You demonstrate strong communication and stakeholder management skills and enjoy collaborating with suppliers, clients, and cross-functional teams. You are fluent in English; German language skills are a plus. You are proactive, team-oriented, and motivated to learn and grow in an international healthcare research environment. Experience working with AI-based solutions, survey platforms, reporting tools, or research technologies is a plus. What we offer At Ipsos, you can expect an international and innovative working environment. We serve renowned clients across almost all major industries and work on exciting projects worldwide! You can look forward to: Hybrid work Flexible working hours Workation in European countries Ipsos Corporate Benefits Subsidy for the Germany public transport ticket (Deutschlandticket) Job rotation opportunities Development & learning culture International collaboration Events & local community Diversity & inclusion initiatives Corporate social responsibility programs Modern workplace Interested? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your application (CV, certificates, and optional a short cover letter) including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations. If you have any questions, please contact:

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

Collaborate in a dynamic, diverse, and innovation-driven environment, where your experience and leadership will be valued.

- 
Design, set up, maintain, and continually enhance our AWS cloud resources using infrastructure-as-code and support the roll-out of new payment products and services from infrastructure perspective.

- 
Take ownership of deployments during releases and ensuring the sound functioning of CI/CD pipelines.

- 
Further develop our data pipeline with integrations to various systems.

- 
Leverage your Datadog expertise to enhance and maintain platform reliability and monitoring.

- 
Drive IT Operations during the roll-out of existing products to new markets and use-cases.

- 
Collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions.

- 
Play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platform.

- 
Ensure compliance of all operational products with Mercedes policies and relevant external laws and regulations.

Qualifikationen WHAT WE EXPECT

A burning passion for IT, along with an open-minded and highly motivated attitude.

- 
Successful completion of relevant studies in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

- 
Strong solution-oriented, problem-solving and analytical skills.

- 
Proficiency in cloud service architecture best practices and experience in writing infrastructure-as-code.

- 
Skilled at Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm and experience with software programming (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and proficiency in the Atlassian Toolchain.

- 
Datadog hands-on experience, and deep understanding of features and capabilities.

- 
Experience with platform reliability best practices, set up of monitors, automated alerts and on-call service.

- 
Knowledge of IT security best practice and common standards.

- Fluent business English skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Modern and dynamic work environment
- Flexible and mobile working
- Attractive fitness offer
- Numerous employee discounts
- Excellent infrastructure

This is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedes

We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips - the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world - like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

As a Supplier Quality Engineer , you will drive supplier performance, lead qualification activities, resolve quality issues, and support continuous improvement initiatives

Applied Materials Integrated Circuit Testing GmbH
Ammerthalstrasse 20
85551 Heimstetten near Munich

Selection, qualification, and auditing of new and existing suppliers
Support in validating suppliers' series production capabilities (statistical process control, implementation of test methods, spare parts management)
Ensuring reliable capacity and infrastructure for high volume production at the supplier
Participation in operational and strategic procurement projects (dual sourcing, change management, capacity projects)
Execution and technical leadership of the product qualification process for critical modules
Integration into the NPI development process in close collaboration with the engineering department
Support of supplier quality control management to continuously improve product standards

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable field
At least 5 years of professional experience, preferably in special purpose machinery or equipment manufacturing
Experience with supplier management and supplier qualification
Knowledge of manufacturing engineering practices, techniques, and methodologies
Confident handling of technical drawings and specifications
Customer and goal oriented working style with a strong sense of responsibility
Flexibility and willingness to work in interdisciplinary teams

Your MissionWe are looking for an Account Executive (f/m/d) to join us on 1 December 2026 and help further establish MakerVerse as a leading platform for on-demand manufacturing in Germany.
In this role, you will bring companies on board with our AI-powered platform and demonstrate the value of solutions such as additive manufacturing, CNC machining, and injection molding. You will work closely with our Customer Acquisition Managers (CAMs), take over qualified leads, and guide them from the specific customer request through the proposal and negotiation stages to a successful close. Along the way, you will build long-term, trusted customer relationships.
This position is ideal for sales-driven professionals who enjoy developing new business opportunities, building lasting customer relationships, actively driving revenue, and taking ownership in a dynamic environment.
You will work remotely from anywhere in Germany. During the third week of each month, you will work with the team at our Berlin office from Tuesday to Thursday. We cover your travel and accommodation expenses. These regular team meetings provide valuable opportunities for in-person collaboration, exchanging ideas, and team activities.

Your Impact
• Sales Responsibility: You will take on qualified sales opportunities and guide customers from their initial requirements through to a confirmed order. You will prioritize your sales opportunities, agree on clear next steps, and keep your pipeline reliably up to date.
• Solution-Oriented Consulting: You will develop and present tailored, technically focused proposals that address our customers’ needs across various manufacturing technologies.
• Customer Relationship Management: You will build and maintain strong customer relationships by serving as a trusted point of contact throughout the entire project lifecycle.
• Customer Development: You will identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships and generate follow-up orders.
• Sales Collaboration: You will work closely with our Customer Acquisition Managers (CAMs) to successfully convert pipeline opportunities into revenue.
• Interdisciplinary Collaboration: You will collaborate with internal teams to ensure the smooth implementation of customer projects, resolve challenges, and identify new business opportunities.

Your DNA
• Closing skills: Ideally, you have two to four years of experience in B2B sales with a proven track record.
• Consultative mindset: You enjoy understanding your customers’ challenges and developing tailored solutions, rather than focusing solely on high outreach volumes.
• Communication skills: You have strong presentation and negotiation skills.
• CRM experience: You are confident in using CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar tools to manage pipelines and create forecasts.
• Team player with ownership: You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally with other teams while taking responsibility for your deals.
• Technical Interest: Curiosity or interest in manufacturing technologies such as CNC machining, additive manufacturing, or injection molding is a major advantage.
• Languages: You are a native-level German speaker, as a significant proportion of our customers are based in the DACH region, and you have very good English skills. Additional language skills are an advantage.

Join Us & Raise the Bar At MakerVerse, we don’t just execute - we innovate. We don’t just meet expectations - we exceed them. If you’re ready to take on responsibility, take on meaningful challenges, and grow as part of a strong team, we look forward to receiving your application.
At MakerVerse, we live by these principles:
• We Own It. We Deliver It. We take responsibility, act with purpose, and go the extra mile to make an impact.
• We Execute Relentlessly. We Solve Big Challenges. We embrace a “doer” mentality and focus on solutions, not problems.
• Our Customers’ Success = Our Success. We make an impact and prioritize what drives our customers’ success.
• We Win Together. We Set the Bar High. We challenge and support one another to give our best and thrive as a high-performing team.

Curious about our employee benefits ? Find more information at www.makerverse.com/careers

About us The future of Digital Manufacturing - Join us today!

MakerVerse is the leading platform for sourcing industrial parts, providing instant access to a vetted supply chain and the full range of manufacturing technologies. With AI-powered quoting, order management, and fulfillment, MakerVerse helps with everything from initial prototypes to full-scale production. Our core philosophy is to combine passionate people with the challenges of tomorrow. We do not believe in fixed job descriptions or CVs but look for diverse personalities who bring their talents, inspirations, and pioneering mindset with them. As a company, we are uniquely positioned to be both VC financed and corporate backed. This allows you to benefit from the best of both worlds - our young, dynamic, and hands-on startup-mentality on the one hand and the stable environment, high reputation of backing by Siemens Energy and ZEISS on the other. We look forward to your application.

jobs.description:
Who we are We are where the future begins – across the globe, GCS creates safe environments by eliminating explosive threats and restoring habitats. Integrating our own innovative, proven technology with on-the-ground operational expertise, we remove landmines and other explosive remnants of war safely and sustainably. We are an owner-managed, independent company headquartered in Switzerland with engineering and production facilities in Germany and regional offices world-wide.
Your Responsibilities
• Active involvement in and support for the implementation of local and group-wide P&C projects (including talent management, succession planning, etc.)
• Support the recruitment process (selection, conducting interviews) in collaboration with the People Business Manager, and support throughout the entire employee lifecycle (payroll, onboarding, development, retention, offboarding) at the Stockach site
• Support the day-to-day management of the Learning Management System (LMS)
• Design and implementation of learning and development (L&D) programmes for the entire group
• Identifying training needs in collaboration with managers, as well as organising and facilitating training sessions, workshops and development programmes in German and English

Your Profile
• A generalist with a People & Culture background, possessing several years’ professional experience and broad practical expertise across the employee life cycle, ranging from day-to-day support and recruitment to the implementation of People & Culture initiatives
• Proven experience in independently leading and implementing People & Culture projects, ideally across multiple sites or groups
• Experience in Learning & Development (design, implementation and facilitation of development programmes) or a strong intrinsic interest in developing further in this area and taking on responsibility
In-depth knowledge of German employment law
• Ability to switch confidently between strategic project work and day-to-day operational tasks, and to set priorities flexibly
• A high degree of initiative, flexibility and motivation, combined with a pragmatic, hands-on approach and a passion for building new initiatives and actively shaping them
• An independent, structured and solution-oriented way of working, as well as a strong ability to deliver results
• Very good written and spoken German and English

We offer youAn opportunity to actively shape the future of our globally operating company and further develop your career. We offer flat hierarchies, a pleasant working atmosphere, flexible working arrangements, and attractive compensation. You can also benefit from various employee programs such as Hansefit, JobRad, Corporate Benefits, internal networking opportunities, and more.

We combine team spirit, integrity, creativity and excellence in every part of our company. Our diverse teams collaborate across Europe, bringing different perspectives together as ONECompany, driven by a shared goal: creating solutions that truly make a difference.

We have the technology, strong clients, and ambitious growth goals. Now were looking for a sales professional who can turn this into our next success story.

- Providing technical and managerial guidance, coaching, and professional development for our sales team
- Responsibility for achieving our revenue and growth targets
- Building and managing a robust sales pipeline, including forecasting
- Acquiring new customers and expanding existing customer relationships
- Developing and implementing sales strategies for the DACH region and our international markets
- Further developing sales processes, CRM usage, and sales playbooks
- Managing and prioritizing strategic target customers and key accounts
- Working closely with Marketing, Pre-Sales, and Customer Success
- Regularly reporting relevant sales metrics to senior management
- Supporting pricing strategies and the expansion of sales partnerships

What we are looking for:

- Several years of experience in a managing sales role in the B2B software sector
- Proven track record of building, leading, and scaling sales teams
- Experience with complex enterprise sales cycles and software solutions that require detailed explanation
- Ideally, industry knowledge in the areas of process automation, low-code, integration, or the energy sector
- Strong leadership and coaching skills
- Strong customer focus and confidence in negotiating at the management level
- High level of initiative, results-oriented mindset, and strategic thinking
- Experience with CRM systems and data-driven sales management
- Ideally, Experience in data management, data governance, process automation, low-code, integration, or related software solutions
- Very good command of German and English

SoftProject GmbH is a leading European provider of data management, process automation, and digital transformation solutions. With our platform, we help organizations unlock the value of their data and build efficient, future-ready processes – from data governance to AI-powered automation.

More than 300 companies across insurance, manufacturing, energy, and the public sector rely on our solutions. With over 230 employees across Europe, we work together on innovative technologies that shape the digital future of our customers.

Following the acquisition by Main Capital Partners in 2024, we continue to grow internationally and are looking for people who want to take ownership, bring in ideas, and shape the future with us.

Lead mechanical design projects from concept through to product release.

Turning, milling, welding, electro-erosion, polishing, etc.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿

Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will lead and execute clinical Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) modeling projects within multidisciplinary systems pharmacology, pharmacometrics, and drug development teams, driving model-informed decision making across development programs.
- Additionally, you will develop, qualify, apply, and communicate fit-for-purpose QSP models that integrate non-clinical, translational, biomarker, and clinical data to address critical scientific and development questions.
- You will also translate biological and pharmacological knowledge into quantitative model structures, assumptions, and simulations, generating actionable insights while clearly communicating model limitations, uncertainties, and their potential impact.
- Furthermore, you will define and drive QSP modeling strategies aligned with project objectives, delivering scientifically robust analyses and interpretations to support clinical development decisions.
- You will provide independent advice on complex mechanistic modeling challenges and represent QSP expertise in cross-functional scientific, technical, and strategic discussions.
- Beyond this, you will provide scientific leadership and guidance throughout model development, qualification, application, and communication activities while fostering collaboration across internal teams and external partners.
- Finally, you will drive innovation, standardization, and digitalization in mechanistic modeling and simulation by evaluating, developing, and implementing novel methodologies, tools, and technologies, while overseeing external modeling activities to ensure scientific excellence and strategic alignment.

Requirements

- PhD or equivalent advanced degree in systems pharmacology, pharmacometrics, clinical pharmacology, computational biology, bioengineering, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
- Several years of hands-on professional experience in QSP modeling in the pharmaceutical industry, regulatory authorities, or relevant academic research
- In-depth knowledge of mechanistic modeling in clinical drug development, including model development, calibration, qualification, simulation, sensitivity analysis, and interpretation of results
- Experience with R and/or relevant QSP modeling platforms such as MATLAB/SimBiology, Julia, OSP Suite, or comparable tools; experience with statistical methods for analysis of nonclinical and clinical data is beneficial
- Strong ability to communicate complex modeling concepts, assumptions, uncertainties, and decision impact clearly to multidisciplinary audiences
- Proven collaboration skills in international, multidisciplinary teams and ability to interact effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including experts, CROs, vendors, and leadership teams
- Fluent in written and spoken English

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, increasing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our team  of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

Fisher Clinical Services GmbH is a subsidiary of Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. and is a market leader in Clinical Supply Chain Management Services and Clinical Supplies for patients worldwide.
You can find out more about our location in Weil am Rhein and Rheinfelden here: www.fisherclinicalservices.com

Discover impactful Work

As a Quality Assurance Specialist (m/f/d) you will play an important role in supporting our Qualified Persons (QPs) throughout the certification and release process for clinical trial materials. Working in a highly regulated GMP/GDP environment, you will help ensure that all required documentation is complete, compliant and available for timely batch certification.

This role offers a unique combination of quality assurance, documentation management and cross-functional collaboration, allowing you to work closely with international customers, project teams and internal stakeholders while contributing directly to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

A Day in the Life

As part of our Quality Assurance team, you will help ensure that clinical trial materials are released accurately, compliantly and on schedule.

Your responsibilities include:

- Preparing, reviewing and compiling documentation required for QP certification and batch release
- Coordinating with customers, Global Project Managers and internal teams to obtain and track quality documentation
- Preparing Certificates of Release, Confirmations of Import and QP Declarations
- Verifying country-specific clinical trial approvals and maintaining release documentation
- Supporting the creation, review and maintenance of SOPs and other quality documents
- Maintaining QP tracking tools, documentation records and compliant archiving practices
- Supporting internal audits, client audits and health authority inspections
- Participating in investigations, CAPA activities and quality system improvements
- Contributing to Permanent Process Improvement (PPI) initiatives and helping optimize QA processes
- You'll work in close collaboration with cross-functional teams and play an important role in ensuring that clinical trial supplies meet the highest quality and regulatory standards before reaching patients around the world.

Keys to Success

Education:

- Completed vocational training as PTA, PKA, CTA, Pharmaceutical Assistant or a comparable qualification

Experience:

- Quality Assurance or Quality Control within the pharmaceutical industry
- Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment
- Previous exposure to documentation management, batch release or clinical supply operations is an advantage

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Good understanding of GMP/GDP requirements and pharmaceutical quality systems
- Structured, detail-oriented and quality-focused approach to work
- Strong organizational and documentation skills
- Customer-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with SharePoint, TrackWise or eDMS is beneficial
- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams
- Fluent German and good English communication skills (written and spoken)

What we offer

- Employment with an innovative, future-oriented organization
- Outstanding career and development prospects
- Company pension scheme and other fringe benefits
- Exciting company culture which stands for integrity, intensity, involvement and innovation

This position offers the opportunity to contribute directly to the quality and compliance of clinical trial supplies while working closely with Qualified Persons, global project teams and international customers. If you enjoy structured work, thrive in a regulated environment and want to make a meaningful impact on patients worldwide, we'd love to hear from you.

With a focus on high-speed PCB layout for embedded and FPGA-based systems, you will develop sophisticated hardware platforms for the professional audio and video broadcast industry while working closely with our in-house production team.

- Design and develop complex multilayer PCBs for FPGA- and embedded-based systems
- Create high-speed layouts for FPGA interfaces, including: - DDR3 / DDR4 / LPDDR memory interfaces
- High-speed SerDes interfaces (e.g., SDI, HDMI, DisplayPort, Ethernet)
- LVDS, MIPI, PCIe, and USB
- Collaborate closely with FPGA and embedded software/hardware development teams
- Work directly with our in-house production team on: - Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA)
- Manufacturing processes, PCB assembly, and testability
- Optimize PCB layouts for volume production, manufacturability, and product quality
- Perform and evaluate Signal Integrity and Power Integrity simulations
- Define PCB stack-ups, layer structures, controlled impedances, and power distribution concepts
- Ensure compliance with EMC, ESD, and reliability requirements
- Prepare and maintain manufacturing, assembly, and test documentation
- Support prototype bring-up, hardware debugging, and transition to volume production

YOUR PROFILE

- Degree in Electrical Engineering or a comparable qualification
- Several years of experience in PCB layout design for FPGA- and embedded-based systems
- Strong knowledge of high-speed PCB design principles, including: - DDR Routing
- Differential pair routing
- Length matching
- Return path optimization
- Proficiency with PCB design tools (experience with Cadence Allegro is preferred)
- Experience with SI and PI simulation tools (e.g., Ansys SIwave and AEDT/HFSS, or equivalent)
- Solid understanding of FPGA architectures, I/O banks, clocking, and power distribution concepts
- Experience collaborating closely with manufacturing and production teams is highly desirable
- Knowledge of broadcast, video, or professional audio systems is an advantage
- Structured, quality-focused working style with strong communication skills
- Excellent English language skills; German and additional languages are considered an advantage

OUR OFFER

- The opportunity to develop high-end FPGA-based systems for the professional broadcast industry
- Close collaboration between engineering and our in-house production team, enabling fast decision-making and efficient development processes
- A high level of ownership and influence over design quality, manufacturability, and production readiness
- A modern development environment with state-of-the-art measurement and test equipment
- A highly motivated team and an international working environment
- Flexible working hours and up to three days of remote work per week
- Competitive salary and an attractive benefits package
- Company pension scheme
- Language courses and other training opportunities
- Daily catered meals with a wide selection of dishes
- A rooftop terrace for breaks and informal meetings
- Employee events
- Table football and a band rehearsal room
- E-Bike Leasing
- ...

Ergänzende Informationen:

Umfang: Maximal 70%
Anforderungen an den Bewerber: 
Expertenkenntnisse: Netzwerktechnik Ethernet, Schaltkreisentwicklung mit FPGA, Bussystem PCI
Zwingend erforderlich: Leiterplatten-Designsysteme (PCB-Design)

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network.

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

Together with selected university partner sites, the German Cancer Research Center has established the German Cancer Consortium (https://dktk.dkfz.de/en) (Deutsches Konsortium für Translationale Krebsforschung, DKTK). The alliance between the DKFZ, as the core center, and the university partner sites in Berlin, Dresden, Essen/Düsseldorf, Frankfurt/Mainz, Freiburg, Heidelberg, Munich, and Tübingen joins forces at eight joint translation centers. The DKTK promotes interdisciplinary preclinical translational research topics to accelerate the transfer of results into new approaches for prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of cancer and to develop strategies for personalized oncology. The consortium supports the training of the next generation of medical and clinician scientists, operates state-of-the-art, highly specialized research infrastructures and technical platforms, and promotes the transfer of innovations to the economy and society.

For the Research Group "Adaptive Glycan Remodeling in Cancer Progression" (https://amulyasreekumar.owlstown.net/)  (headed by Amulya Sreekumar) at the DKTK partner site Berlin, the DKFZ is seeking, starting in January 2027, a PhD Student in Cancer Biology.

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD student to investigate the mechanisms driving breast cancer progression. Approximately 30% of breast cancer patients who are disease-free after initial therapy ultimately develop local or metastatic recurrences seeded by therapy-evasive residual tumor cells. Such cells often exist in a dormant state and subsequently exit dormancy, thus giving rise to recurrences. We are interested in the molecular mechanisms that promote residual tumor cell persistence after therapy and their subsequent reactivation.
Building on our recent discovery that tumor cell-autonomous glycan biosynthesis supports dormant cell persistence, this project aims to identify therapeutic strategies that disrupt glycan-mediated signaling to eliminate residual tumor cells and prevent lethal recurrence. The work will integrate mechanistic molecular biology, functional genomics, and advanced cancer models to achieve this goal.

The successful candidate will join the DKFZ International PhD Program (https://www.dkfz.de/en/career/international-phd-program) and work in a collaborative environment spanning DKFZ and Charité/DKTK Berlin. This partnership provides access to cutting-edge core facilities, including high-content imaging, flow cytometry, and genomics technologies at both institutions.
Our laboratory is located within the Department of Hematology, Oncology, and Cancer Immunology at Charité-Campus Virchow Klinikum in Berlin.

Your Tasks

- Performing molecular biology, cell biology, and biochemistry experiments using human and murine breast cancer models 
- Working with genetically engineered mouse models and transplantable tumors
- Gaining problem-solving and analytical skills through active participation and training
- Integration and interpretation of data 
- Presenting research findings at national/international conferences
- Contributing to high-impact scientific publications

Your Profile

- Master's degree in biology, biochemistry, or a related life sciences discipline 
- Strong interest in cancer research and the molecular mechanisms underlying disease progression
- Practical experience in molecular biology
- Mammalian cell culture experience and an interest in working with mouse models are desirable 
- Collaborative, highly motivated working style with good attention to detail
- Excellent written and spoken English

What makes this Position special:

- A fully funded PhD position within the DKFZ International PhD Program
- Close supervision and mentoring in an international research environment 
- Participate in collaborations with leading cancer research groups
- Hands-on experience using cutting-edge technologies, including CRISPR-based functional genomics, next-generation sequencing, imaging, and advanced disease models 
- Access to excellent core facilities at both DKFZ Heidelberg and Charité Berlin

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- Access to international research networks
- Doctoral salary with the usual social benefits
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted training and mentoring through the DKFZ International PhD Program and DKFZ Career Service
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Amulya Sreekumar
Phone: +49 (0)30 450 559399

Duration: The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of prolongation.

Application Deadline: September 16, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.

Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Global Head of Procurement & Logistics (f/m/d) for Digital Grid (DG), you will lead the global procurement and logistics organization and shape the function as a strategic business partner, value creator, and digital innovator. You will define and execute DG's global procurement and logistics strategy, strengthen supply chain resilience, drive operational excellence, and accelerate the adoption of AI, data, and digital technologies across the end-to-end value chain.

You will partner closely with business leaders, engineering, operations, finance, logistics, and digitalization teams to build a future-ready operating model that improves competitiveness, delivery reliability, compliance, and sustainable business performance.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Define and execute a global procurement and logistics strategy that aligns with business objectives, ensuring growth, profitability, and delivery commitments.
* Build and manage a high-performing global supplier ecosystem, driving supplier development and risk mitigation strategies to enhance material availability and business continuity.
* Champion the transformation of procurement and logistics into a data-driven function by identifying and scaling AI use cases to enhance decision-making and business performance.
* Deliver measurable business value through cost optimization, productivity improvements, and logistics efficiency, while fostering a culture of ownership, integrity, excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Lead and develop a globally distributed team, focusing on building high-performing cross-functional teams and strengthening future capabilities through talent development and inclusive leadership.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, connecting business strategy with procurement and logistics execution to drive overall organizational success.

What You Bring

* A degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Economics, Logistics, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is equally valued.
* Many years of experience in procurement, supply chain, logistics, or strategic sourcing within a global industrial or technology-driven organization.
* Several years of success in leading global and cross-functional teams, managing stakeholders across various regions and functions.
* Experience leading or contributing to analytics, automation, AI, or digital transformation initiatives in procurement, supply chain, logistics, operations, or a comparable environment.
* Strong commercial, financial, contractual, supplier management, negotiation, and risk-management expertise.
* Proficient communication in English with the ability to translate business needs into practical priorities, decisions, and measurable outcomes.

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs
